question: Which mineral found in the Koderma and Giridih districts of Jharkhand is used for power industry, paint and pigment industry etc.?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Mica.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Micas are a group of silicate minerals **whose outstanding physical characteristic is that individual mica crystals can easily be split into extremely thin elastic plates.
 
• The major uses of sheet and block mica are as** electrical insulators in electronic equipment, thermal insulation, gauge “glass”etc.**
 
• **Koderma** is one of the districts of Jharkhand with abundant natural resources and rich mineral deposits throughout the district.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kyanite** is used primarily in** refractory and ceramic products,** including porcelain plumbing and dishware.

 
 
• It is also used in electronics, electrical insulators. **.**
 
 
 
• **Quartz is a hard, crystalline mineral composed of silica.**
 
 
• **I**n India was produced in Andhra Pradesh it has maximum amount.
 
• The other states where include **Gujarat, Rajasthan, West Bengal, Karnataka, Jharkhand**, etc.
 
 
 
• **Asbestos **is a naturally occurring fibrous silicate mineral.
 
 
• There are six types, all of which are composed of long and thin fibrous crystals ,In india, asbestos occurs in the states of** Andra Pradesh, Rajastan, Bihar, Karnataka, Tamilnadu and Manipur **
